claims.originalText: Art Institute of Chicago catalogues this object as "Pair of Teabowls with Bamboo".

qualifiers.editorialScope: Attributed catalogue evidence; no independent authentication is implied.

variants.text: Art Institute of Chicago catalogues this object as "Pair of Teabowls with Bamboo".
芝加哥藝術博物館將此器著錄為「竹紋對茶碗」。

claims.originalText: Art Institute of Chicago gives the date as "Qing dynasty (1644–1911), Yongzheng reign mark and period (1723–1735)".

qualifiers.editorialScope: Attributed catalogue evidence; no independent authentication is implied.

variants.text: Art Institute of Chicago gives the date as "Qing dynasty (1644–1911), Yongzheng reign mark and period (1723–1735)".

claims.originalText: Art Institute of Chicago records the medium as "Porcelain painted in underglaze blue and overglaze enamels (doucai)".

qualifiers.editorialScope: Attributed catalogue evidence; no independent authentication is implied.

variants.text: Art Institute of Chicago records the medium as "Porcelain painted in underglaze blue and overglaze enamels (doucai)".

claims.originalText: The museum's credit line reads "Bequest of Henry C. Schwab"; it is an attributed acquisition credit.

qualifiers.editorialScope: Attributed catalogue evidence; no independent authentication is implied.

claims.originalText: This catalogue material designation describes the recorded museum object; it is not a laboratory identification or an authentication of an unexamined collector object.

claims.originalText: Outlines of bamboo were painted in cobalt and covered with a transparent glaze before firing. The leaves were then colored with pale green, yellow, and red enamels, and the bowls refired at a lower temperature.

qualifiers.editorialScope: Attributed catalogue evidence; no independent authentication is implied.

variants.text: Outlines of bamboo were painted in cobalt and covered with a transparent glaze before firing. The leaves were then colored with pale green, yellow, and red enamels, and the bowls refired at a lower temperature.
竹紋先以鈷料勾線，罩透明釉後燒成；葉片再填以淡綠、黃、紅琺瑯彩，並以較低溫度復燒。
